findings.issue: No test script, runner, or test dependency anywhere in the app; ~650 LOC of subtle filtering/sorting/pagination/cache logic is guarded only by the external acceptance suite
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or node:test) plus a few unit tests for the pure helpers (humanize, dexNumber, homeUrl, parseHomeQuery, sortRows, latestFlavorText, englishEffect, idFromUrl) — all are mock-free and would cost under an hour

findings.issue: serve() is called at module top level and the Hono app is never exported, so in-process app.request()-style tests cannot be written without spawning a server
findings.suggestion: Export the Hono app (or a createApp() factory) and start the server only when the module is the entry point (import.meta.url check)

findings.issue: SWR cache: 404→null vs throw contract, pending-request dedup, and swallowed background-refresh errors are all untested; every route's notFound handling depends on these semantics
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the api() client against a stubbed fetch: 404 returns null, 5xx throws, stale value served while refresh runs, refresh failure keeps stale value

findings.issue: sortRows' missing-values-last-in-both-directions and label/level tie-breaks are untested; the acceptance suite never checks descending order with null values
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests over sortRows covering nulls in both directions, numeric vs string columns, and tie-breaks

findings.issue: URL state edge cases untested: page=0/negative/garbage parsing, clamping past the last page, and default-parameter omission in homeUrl
findings.suggestion: Unit tests for parseHomeQuery and homeUrl (pure functions), plus one for loadHome page clamping with a stubbed data layer

findings.issue: loadMoves silently drops a move when its detail fetch fails or 404s; no test would catch moves vanishing from tables
findings.suggestion: Test loadMoves with a mix of successful and failing move fetches; decide explicitly whether to retry, render a placeholder, or surface an error

findings.issue: cardsForPokemon (alternate-form exclusion, dedup, dex ordering) is shared by move, ability and type pages but untested; a change for one page can silently break the others
findings.suggestion: Unit tests with refs including IDs ≥10000, duplicates (deoxys-normal + deoxys), and out-of-order refs

findings.issue: 404 and 500 error paths (notFound handler, app.onError) are untested
findings.suggestion: Once the app is exportable, request a bogus /pokemon/does-not-exist and assert the 404 status and rendered heading; assert onError renders the fallback page

findings.issue: typesByPokemonId slot ordering and cross-type dedup logic untested; wrong slot order would mis-render home-page cards
findings.suggestion: Unit test with a Pokémon whose two types are listed in reverse slot order across the type records

findings.issue: latestFlavorText ('last en entry', whitespace collapse) and englishEffect ($effect_chance substitution) are pure and spec-pinned but untested
findings.suggestion: Straightforward unit tests with synthetic entries; also cover the $effect_chance-with-null-chance case

summary: The agent wrote no tests of its own: no test files, no runner, and a package.json whose only verification script is typecheck. This is especially costly here because the riskiest logic — the SWR cache's null/throw contract, move-table sorting with missing values, pagination clamping, and shared card mapping — is largely pure, mock-free code that would have been cheap to test. Worse, the server is started at import time and the app isn't exported, so adding in-process route tests later requires structural changes first. Once the acceptance suite stops being the only guard, refactors to this code will land blind.
